subject: gov.standards
name: Mobile quality-of-service thresholds
what_would_settle_it: The text of ARCEP decision n°000012/ARCEP/CNRCEP/21 of 10 December 2021, or any official statement of the indicators and thresholds mobile operators are measured against.
disposition: absence stands, dated - ARCEP's 2024 annual report has since arrived and carries the subscriber and penetration series but not the quality-of-service indicators or the thresholds operators are measured against. The 2021 decision's text and the four mises en demeure remain unpublished.

subject: finance.sustain
name: Outturn against the digital appropriations
what_would_settle_it: A loi de règlement for 2024 or 2025, or an execution report by section, programme or activity, read into the budget extract; the provisional quarterly reports give execution by economic title only.

subject: finance.sustain
name: Revenue terms of the identity-document partnership
what_would_settle_it: The public-private partnership agreement with Al Itissal Al Jadeed for the passport and electronic identity card, stating how the firm's financing is recovered (fee share, concession term) and the state's obligation.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Data jurisdiction, portability and exit terms of the identity-document contract
what_would_settle_it: Publication of the Al Itissal Al Jadeed agreements or a ministry statement on data ownership, hosting, source code and exit for the passport and identity-card systems.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Where the biometric identity database is hosted
what_would_settle_it: A ministry, ANEI or vendor statement of where the biometric identity and population-register databases are hosted and under whose jurisdiction.

subject: geopol.sovereignty
name: Rule on where state data is held
what_would_settle_it: A government hosting or data-classification instrument, or a decree governing the national data centre's use, fixing where state data may be held.
